items.title: Live: Iran vows to turn Strait of Hormuz into 'hell' after US launches more strikes
items.description: The US military says it has launched a series of strikes on "multiple targets" in Iran. Follow live.

items.title: State disability ministers lash NDIS overhaul
items.description: State and territory disability ministers have accused the Albanese government of pushing on with NDIS reform that does not align with previous agreements.

items.title: Culture in Australia's largest police force 'unacceptable'
items.description: Bullying, discrimination and sexual harassment are occurring at "unacceptable levels" within the NSW Police Force and employees are too afraid to speak up, an independent report has found.

items.title: Melbourne aged care COVID outbreak back in spotlight
items.description: An inquest examining 50 COVID-era deaths at a Melbourne aged care home has resumed after a years-long hiatus.

items.title: Consumer watchdog warns real estate agents must not misrepresent homes
items.description: Real estate agents selling homes must not misrepresent information about the builder or serious defects, SA's consumer watchdog has said, after eight builders were hit with public warning notices over their conduct in the state.

items.title: Stabbing victim's family calls for calm amid violent protests in Northern Ireland
items.description: The family of a Northern Irish man who lost an eye in a knife attack has appealed for calm ​after anti-immigrant violence in Belfast.

items.title: Ebola outbreak grows to almost 600 confirmed cases
items.description: In just two weeks the number of confirmed Ebola virus cases has increased more than eightfold, with at least 100 people now dead.

items.title: Notorious Sydney gang rapist Mohammed Skaf facing drug charges
items.description: NSW Police arrested the 42-year-old in Greenacre in Sydney's south-west overnight and he has been charged with 24 offences.

items.title: Massive whale graveyard found in deep ocean off Australia
items.description: Hundreds of whale fossils, including those from extinct species new to science, range in age from recent to 5 million years old and are also home to undescribed deep-sea creatures.

items.title: Albanese's frustration with Trump is becoming harder to hide
items.description: The Albanese government is paying an economic and political toll for an ongoing and deeply unpopular war.

items.title: Taylor rules out One Nation seat carve-up as party raises $2m
items.description: Opposition leader Angus Taylor says the Coalition has no plan to share the seats the party targets at the next federal election with One Nation as Pauline Hanson's party says it has raised $2 million since launch.

items.title: Grandfather's fall inspires 20yo student's smart clock invention
items.description: After it took nearly two days for his grandfather to be found following a serious fall, Kai Gould has created a device to connect older people living independently with their loved ones.

items.title: 'Just chill, relax': Infantino defends World Cup visa issues, ticket prices
items.description: FIFA president Gianni Infantino defends soccer's governing body's handling of visa issues and ticket prices ahead of the World Cup.

items.title: Gout would be wise to take heed of Olympic gold medallist's advice
items.description: Gout Gout can benefit from Letsile Tebogo's wisdom, as the Olympic champion knows what it is like to make the challenging transition from junior star to the senior ranks.

items.title: Steven Spielberg returns to sci-fi and alien wonder in Disclosure Day
items.description: ET director Steven Spielberg dives back into the extra terrestrial with his latest film while asking 'How do you astonish an audience when anything is possible, and nothing is real?

items.title: In Moldova, I met a woman with a dangerous plan to save her life
items.description: On a park bench in Moldova, I meet a Ukrainian refugee who is planning to return home through a war zone for cancer treatment. We talk for hours.

items.title: How well do you know Aussie books? Take our quiz to find out
items.description: Occupy yourself with some armchair travel courtesy of a selection of our nation's most esteemed literary works.

items.title: What time does the FIFA World Cup kick-off, Australian time?
items.description: Check out when your team's matches are kicking off at the 2026 FIFA World Cup so you don't miss a match.

items.title: Government flags risk of relying on Elon Musk's SpaceX and Starlink
items.description: As tens of thousands of Australians line up to buy shares in Elon Musk's SpaceX blockbuster public offering, Australian government officials are privately flagging the risks posed by the country's growing reliance on its satellite internet service, Starlink.

items.title: Police up ante after prisoner's escape from brother's Melbourne funeral
items.description: A prisoner who absconded from his brother's funeral in Melbourne's north-west on Anzac Day continues to evade detection.

items.title: 'Very unfair': Collapsed petrol empire lands deal to pay fraction of $13m debt
items.description: The directors of Zoya Investments have agreed to a $2 million settlement to end the liquidator's case against them.

items.title: 'It is what it is': Solomon Islands says it can't release details of China security deal
items.description: Prime Minister Matthew Wale says it is legally impossible to publish the final document because the Sogavare government made binding commitments to the Chinese government when it signed the agreement in 2022.

items.title: Beachside towns in WA face difficult decisions as erosion gets worse
items.description: A week after Western Australia experienced one of its worst storms in decades, some stretches of coast are crumbling into the ocean at an alarming rate. Millions of dollars' worth of infrastructure is at risk heading into winter.

items.title: $100k payout after theft of iconic Tasmanian wool trophy
items.description: The trophy features a sculpture that includes a 24-carat gold merino sheep and a weaving loom made of silver and platinum, with its theft last year captured on CCTV.

items.title: Predictive text in 'demonstrable decline' with AI-based language models
items.description: If internet chatter is to be believed, the intuitiveness and efficiency of predictive text and autocorrect have fallen off a cliff in recent years. But while researchers agree there has been a demonstrable decline in quality, the increasing sophistication of what phones can do is also making errors more prominent.
